### UTC Date & Time

[July 09, 2026, 14:00 UTC](https://savvytime.com/converter/utc/jul-9-2026/2pm)

### Agenda
Devnet updates:

- Devnet-6 update
- Devnet-7 timeline, when can we have clients ready with it? 
- EIP-7688 (Progressive containers) — Status update from Prysm/Lighthouse. What work is left before branches are done? 


Other topics:

- ePBS circuit breakers — Decided in ACDC#181: client-specific implementations acceptable, track missing payloads (not beacon blocks). Terence — Prysm was using beacon-block-based breaker; needs fix to incorporate payload status (few lines of code per Terence). tbenr — Teku hasn't implemented yet. Status check: which clients have circuit breakers ready for DevNet 7/mainnet?

Glamsterdam:
- EIP-8282 (Builder Execution Requests) — Contract finalization + audit timeline. Signal when contract is final for audit (target end July, post DevNet 7).


Hegota:
- Hegota non-headliner window closing date

#### EIP-7723 Follow-up: Clarifications & Implementation
- Update Glamsterdam Meta EIP-7773 - Ref: [PR](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/11853)
- Clarify EIP Status vs. Network Upgrade Stage terminology to avoid confusion. Ref: [PR](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/11006)
- Confirm the process for removing DFI EIPs from the Upgrade Meta EIP when the Meta EIP progresses to `Review` status. Ref: [Discussion](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/11855#issuecomment-4872040005)
  - Proposal - Update EIP-7723 to clarify DFI process Ref:[PR](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/11904)
- Correct the implementation of EIP-7723 by clarifying that Network Upgrade Stages apply only to `Standards Track - Core` EIPs, not to "other EIP" categories.
- Revisit the Pectra, Fusaka, and Glamsterdam Meta EIPs to align formatting and terminology with the finalized EIP-7723 process.

Authors may please take a look at open PRs, address any open requests by editors, and add approvals, if appropriate.
- maybe we can quickly talk about https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/624
Would like to discuss a “public devnet” or I guess more a Mekong style testnet to allow for applications to have a staging environment for gloas
This meeting occurred more than 24 hours ago. Closing automatically.
